name: Create a repository Actions policy
description: Create a repository Actions policy Create an Actions policy for a repository. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/policies
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/policies
Create an Actions policy for a repository. Omitting `workflow_path` targets all workflows without storing an explicit condition.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body) — Request body

name: Delete a repository Actions policy
description: Delete a repository Actions policy Delete an Actions policy for a repository. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/policies/{policy_id}

name: List repository Actions policies
description: List repository Actions policies List all Actions policies for a repository. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/policies
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/policies
List all Actions policies for a repository.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; has_parents (query) — Include policies configured at higher levels that apply to this repository

name: Get a repository Actions policy
description: Get a repository Actions policy Get a specific Actions policy for a repository. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/policies/{policy_id}

name: Update a repository Actions policy
description: Update a repository Actions policy Update an Actions policy for a repository. PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/policies/{policy_id}
